title: Cedar Point retail access
goal: Show retail footprint, counted parking, accessible bays, and circulation.

rubric.must: A clearly labelled retail building footprint is visible.
The north parking field visibly states 54 bays and includes a separate 4-bay accessible area.
Primary entry aisle and service access visibly connect parking to Cedar Avenue.
A labelled accessible route visibly joins the accessible bays to the customer entrance.
Frontage dimension, north arrow, scale, and legend are visible.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the siteplan exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: All required site-plan elements are clearly visible and consistent with the source data: labelled retail footprint, counted parking and accessible bays, road connections, accessible route, dimensions, north arrow, scale, and legend.

items.evidence: A distinct footprint is clearly labelled “RETAIL BUILDING” and “24,000 sf.”
The parking field visibly states “NORTH PARKING · 54 BAYS,” with a separate blue area labelled “4 accessible bays.”
The labelled “PRIMARY ENTRY AISLE · 24′” and “Service access · 18′” are visibly drawn connecting the parking/building area to Cedar Avenue.
A blue dashed accessible route visibly runs from the accessible bays along the building frontage to the marked and labelled customer entrance.
The 440 ft frontage dimension, 310.00′ parcel depth, north arrow, graphic scale, and legend are all visible.
